name: What is the process for building a backyard tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes?
description: Our process involves consultation, design, permit acquisition, construction, and final inspections. We manage each step to ensure a smooth and compliant build.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for building a backyard tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your needs and evaluate your property for feasibility. Next, we assist with design and architectural plans, ensuring they comply with all local zoning and building regulations. This is followed by permit acquisition, which we manage on your behalf. Once permits are secured, our experienced team handles all aspects of construction, from foundation to finish. We conclude with final inspections and handover, ensuring your new tiny home is ready for occupancy. We strive for a transparent and efficient building experience.
